title: 第9章 东海龙王的震惊第10章 收服龙族一统洪荒
slug: 重生商纣开局怒怼圣人女娲
content_zh:
第9章东海龙王的震惊！就在昊天去天外找鸿钧时，洪荒大陆各大圣人再度被惊动。
不过他们都是天道圣人，虽然现在天道混乱，但也知道这是天道运转的一种，而处于天道之下的他们，自然不能插手干预。
与昊天慌乱到不知所措不同，短短片刻，众多圣人就压下心中的震惊，不再理会！
就连针对帝辛的女娲，也只是在一愣之后选择闭关！
唯有火云洞三皇，一个个激动得无与伦比——
伏羲倒吸一口凉气道：“嘶……天道再动，人道再动，这个后人不简单啊！”
神农笑眯眯地轻抚胡须道：“的确，这帝辛颇有我们上古时期的魄力，我们三兄弟给他背锅也值了，我很看好这个小伙子！”
轩辕更是大笑道：“可惜我们三兄弟不能离开火云洞，人道之力刚刚复苏，一个人皇玺还不足以镇压人族气运，既然我们无法现身帮他，那就全力镇压人族气运吧！”
说到最后的时候，轩辕的声音中已经多出一股杀伐之意。
人道之力终于复苏，但是人族内部已经开始四分五裂，气运不凝之下，人皇玺也只能定住殷商核心部分的气运。
八百诸侯国分摊的殷商气运，始终是大患！
三皇看得很清楚，
但，
他们却无法离开火云洞，哪怕是神识都不可以！
一旦他们有任何异动，人道气运说不定还会散开，到时候就得不偿失了！
听到轩辕的话后，伏羲和神农无奈地看了彼此一眼，齐齐点头道：“三弟说的是！”
不知过了多久，
伏羲的喃喃自语声，在火云洞中响起——
“等女娲前来，我会让他去找太上取回崆峒印，若崆峒印和人皇玺齐聚朝歌镇压气运，人族才会真正无忧啊！”
但无论是神农还是轩辕，都没有开口，

他们清楚，
之前女娲前去朝歌质问人皇，之后又去了紫霄宫、西方教，都没有来火云洞见自己的哥哥，
现在更不可能来了！
她和伏羲有兄妹之情，但也仅限于伏羲，跟人族没有关系！
……
与此同时，
四海龙族却突遭劫难！
黄飞虎宣人皇诏，引动洪荒大陆人道气运再度复苏，降下滔天神威垂落四海。
四海之中，所有龙族全都感受到一股，完全不次于圣人般可怕的威压降临！
特别是齐聚东海的四海龙王，
在黄飞虎宣召结束的瞬间，双脚一软，同时瘫倒在了地上。
“大哥，这人皇诏怎么会有这么恐怖的力量，仅仅宣读一番，就让我等有种面对祖龙的感觉！”西海龙王傲闰震惊道。
“是啊大哥，听说不久前女娲圣人前去朝歌质问人皇，却被他一剑断掉了和人族的因果，还险些将女娲圣人打落圣位，看来这不是谣传啊！”北海龙王敖顺颤声道。
“大哥，我等归附天庭，多年来他们除了把我们当奴隶，就是把我们当食物，这个人皇敢和圣人硬杠，若是归顺他，说不定也是我们重新崛起的机会！”南海龙王敖钦说道。

content_en:
Chapter 9 The Dragon King of the East China Sea is shocked! Just when Haotian went to Tianwai to find Hongjun, the great saints in the ancient continent were alarmed again.
However, they are all saints of Heavenly Dao. Although Heavenly Dao is in chaos now, they also know that this is a kind of movement of Heavenly Dao, and they, who are under Heavenly Dao, naturally cannot interfere.
Unlike Haotian who was so flustered that he didn't know what to do, in just a few moments, many saints suppressed the shock in their hearts and stopped paying attention!
Even Nuwa, who was targeting Di Xin, only chose to retreat after being stunned!
Only the three emperors of Huoyundong were extremely excited -
Fuxi took a breath of cold air and said: "Hiss... if the way of heaven moves again, if the way of humanity moves again, this descendant will not be simple!"
Shennong smiled and stroked his beard and said: "Indeed, this Emperor Xin has the courage of our ancient times. It is worth it for us three brothers to take the blame for him. I am very optimistic about this young man!"
Xuanyuan laughed even more and said: "It's a pity that we three brothers can't leave the Fire Cloud Cave. The power of humanity has just recovered. One Human Emperor's Seal is not enough to suppress the destiny of the human race. Since we can't show up to help him, then let's suppress the destiny of the human race with all our strength!"
When he said the last words, Xuanyuan's voice already had a killing intent.
The power of humanity has finally recovered, but the human race has begun to fall apart. If the destiny is not condensed, the Human Emperor's Seal can only stabilize the destiny of the core part of the Yin Shang.
The fortune of the Yin and Shang dynasties, shared among the eight hundred vassal states, is always a serious problem!
The Three Emperors saw clearly,
But,
But they couldn't leave the Fire Cloud Cave, not even with their spiritual consciousness!
Once they make any changes, the luck of humanity may spread, and then the gains outweigh the losses!
After hearing Xuanyuan's words, Fuxi and Shennong looked at each other helplessly, nodded in unison and said, "The third brother is right!"
I don’t know how long it took,
Fuxi's muttering sounded in the Fire Cloud Cave——
"When Nuwa comes, I will ask him to go to the Supreme Being to retrieve the Kongtong Seal. If the Kongtong Seal and the Human Emperor's Seal gather in Chaoge to suppress the luck, the human race will truly have no worries!"
But neither Shennong nor Xuanyuan spoke.
They know
Nuwa went to Chaoge to question the Human Emperor before, and then went to Zixiao Palace and the Western Sect, but she did not come to Huoyun Cave to see her brother.
It’s even less likely to come now!
She and Fuxi have a brother-sister relationship, but it is limited to Fuxi and has nothing to do with the human race!
…
At the same time,
The Dragon Clan of the Four Seas suddenly suffered a disaster!
Huang Feihu promulgated the emperor's edict, causing the human destiny of the ancient continent to revive again, and raining down overwhelming divine power across the sea.
In the four seas, all the dragon clans felt the coming of a terrifying pressure that was no less than that of a saint!
Especially the dragon kings of the four seas gathered in the East China Sea,
At the moment when Huang Feihu's call was over, his feet went weak and he collapsed on the ground.
"Brother, how can this human emperor's edict have such terrifying power? Just reading it out makes us feel like we are facing the ancestral dragon!" Ao Run, the Dragon King of the West Sea, said in shock.
"Yes, brother, I heard that Saint Nuwa went to Chaoge to question the Human Emperor not long ago, but he cut off the relationship with the human race with his sword, and almost knocked Saint Nuwa off the throne. It seems that this is not a rumor!" Beihai Dragon King Ao Shun said in a trembling voice.
"Brother, we have surrendered to Heaven. Over the years, they have treated us not only as slaves, but also as food. This Human Emperor dares to confront the saint. If we surrender to him, it might be an opportunity for us to rise again!" Ao Qin, the Dragon King of the South China Sea, said.
